unit_note: total_planned_job_launches counts JOB LAUNCHES, not scalar observations. A sweep job contains several arms (e.g. HF batches 1/4/16); ranks within one job and requests within one session are NOT independent repeats.

training.gradient_clipping: native paths: none; DeepSpeed config sets gradient_clipping=1.0 (a recorded recipe difference, not claimed equivalent)
training.dropout: GPT2Config defaults (resid/embd/attn 0.1); RNG controlled and replayed for the matched reference
training.precisions: FP32 everywhere; AMP-fp16 retained on TITAN RTX only
training.scaling: global batch = 4N at world size N => WEAK scaling, not fixed-global-batch strong scaling
training.baseline_rule: each recipe uses its OWN same-wrapper N=1 baseline, measured afresh in the same blocked campaign
training.quality_claims: none; no equal-quality or time-to-quality claim follows

cnn.work_label: ANALYTICAL work, not occupancy; AMP carries no percentage of FP32 peak
cnn.energy_denominator: actual complete-work interval, NOT an assumed exactly-60-second denominator

inference.vllm_launch_shape: ONE parent per case, local multiprocessing, not Ray
inference.throughput_def: total output tokens / matching end-to-end generation interval, NOT reciprocal median latency

collectives.note_497: 497 MiB = 521142272 B is ~4.7% LARGER than the 497759232 B gradient volume
collectives.bandwidth_label: ring-equivalent NORMALISATION, not measured wire traffic; no topology causality

streaming.server: one fresh loopback-only server per block
streaming.reporting: session variation + descriptive request summaries only; no tail percentiles, no internal GPU TTFT, no chunk-gap-as-ITL

timing.sync: CUDA synchronize at both measurement boundaries
timing.distributed_throughput: total completed work over the COMMON job interval; never summed rank rates nor the fastest rank; per-rank timings persisted with their relation to that interval
timing.gap_rule: 3 x the CONFIGURED nominal interval, declared before data; never an observed mean
timing.diagnostics: timed observers declared; audit-instrumented throughput labelled; no zero-overhead claim without evidence

statistics.estimand: median throughput per measurement arm across 6 sessions
statistics.report: every point, median, sample CV, range/median
statistics.interval: [min,max] over 6 IID continuous observations = 31/32 pointwise median coverage
statistics.not: not simultaneous intervals; not a global significance ranking
statistics.extension: no automatic extra blocks beyond six
statistics.partial: n<6 receives no six-block confidence claim
statistics.exclusions: prespecified validity only; a valid slow run is never excluded for being slow
